## Safety checklist

- [ ] No unrelated files or generated churn
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, cookies, tokens, or private values
- [ ] No owner-account or smoke-account special-casing
- [ ] Identity remains server-derived for protected operations
- [ ] No production database mutation without explicit authorization
- [ ] Documentation and `AI_WORKSPACE` remain synchronized
- [ ] PR body describes the exact current head

## Rico product gate

Complete when behavior, intent routing, tools, attachments, CV/document handling, job search, or applications are affected.

- [ ] Answers exactly what the user asked
- [ ] No unwanted job search or unrelated action
- [ ] No success claim before authoritative persistence/read-back
- [ ] Arabic/English parity considered where relevant
- [ ] Uncertainty is stated rather than converted into a false claim
- [ ] The change improves user trust globally, not for one sampled account
